import collections

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    overall_bg = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != overall_bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != overall_bg]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(row_cuts, row_cuts[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    col_bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(col_cuts, col_cuts[1:]) if b > a + 1]
    blocks = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_bands for c0, c1 in col_bands]
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1, c0, c1 in blocks for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    bg = collections.Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def score(b):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = b
        cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
        return (sum(v != bg for v in cells), len(set(cells)))
    tr0, tr1, tc0, tc1 = max(blocks, key=score)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            if r1-r0 == tr1-tr0 and c1-c0 == tc1-tc0:
                for dr in range(r1-r0):
                    for dc in range(c1-c0):
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[tr0+dr][tc0+dc]
    return out
